purpose: Diagnostic-only, zero-training calibration of 6-UAV task discriminability before any new formal UTR/DRTP experiment.

candidates.description: Exact fault-step=3 v2 geometry, retained as the known ceiling reference.

A one-and-a-half-fold terminal route (30 distance units) with a one-step legal cache horizon. This retains the native role geometry and action scale while requiring post-fault information renewal to complete a task.

A two-fold terminal route (40 distance units) with the same one-step legal cache horizon. It tests whether a slightly longer post-fault support requirement remains nominally solvable for frozen endpoints.
Longer post-fault task path with the original cache horizon; tests whether trajectory duration alone removes the ceiling.
Same longer path but shorter legal cache freshness; tests whether ongoing path support, rather than merely fault occurrence, yields discriminable topology pressure.

eligibility_rule.interpretation: A candidate passing this rule is eligible for a separately reviewed formal protocol; passing does not authorize training or establish a DRTP advantage.
